description: 意大利开局 C54 — Re1预先占领e线，施压黑方e5中心

intro.popup:
线路控制第9课
Re1——预先布控e线！
e线还有兵，但车提前就位
等待时机，施压黑方e5中心
intro.popup_en:
Line Control, Lesson 9
Re1 prepares to control the e-file in advance. The pawns still block it, but the rook is already in place, ready to pressure Black's e5 center when the time comes.

outro.popup:
预控总结
Re1在e线上的价值
1. 施压黑方e5中心兵
2. 为d4推进后的开放做准备
3. 与Bc4形成纵线+斜线协同
先布线，再等开放——黑方也在沉着应对！
outro.popup_en: Summary: Re1 pressures Black's e5 pawn, prepares for the file to open after d4, and works with Bc4 to coordinate a file and a diagonal. Place the rook first, then wait for the line to open; Black is also preparing to contest it.

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game and occupies the center.
moves.popup:
e4开局
占中心

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's move, and both pawns block the e-file.
moves.popup:
e5对称
双方封闭e线

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and attacks e5.
moves.popup:
Nf3发展
攻击e5

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and defends e5, a standard reply.
moves.popup:
Nc6保护e5
标准应对

moves.popup_en: Bc4 develops the Italian bishop actively and targets f7.
moves.popup:
Bc4意大利象
瞄准f7，积极发展

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops a black piece.
moves.popup:
Nf6发展
黑方出子

moves.popup_en: d3 reinforces the center in the Giuoco Pianissimo setup. White does not rush d4 and first completes development.
moves.popup:
d3稳固中心
意大利封闭体系
不急于d4，先完成发展

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops and prepares Black to castle.
moves.popup:
Be7发展
准备王车易位

moves.popup_en: O-O activates the rook on f1. White can now play Rfe1 immediately.
moves.popup:
O-O王车易位
f1车激活
注意：王车易位后立刻就能Rfe1！

moves.popup_en: ...d6 stabilizes Black's center.
moves.popup:
d6稳固
黑方巩固中心

moves.popup_en: Re1! White places the rook on the e-file in advance. The pawns on e4 and e5 still block it, but once e5 is exchanged the file can open at once. This is the essence of preparing control before the line opens.
moves.popup:
Re1！提前布控e线！
e线现在还有兵（e4和e5）
但车在e1——等待时机
一旦e5兵被兑换，e线立刻开放
Re1预先就位，是预控e线的精华

moves.popup_en: ...O-O activates Black's rook on f8. Black may challenge the e-file with ...Re8, but White's rook is already in position.
moves.popup:
黑方王车易位
f8车激活
黑方也可以Re8对抗e线
但白方Re1已经先行就位

moves.popup_en: c3 prepares d4. If White advances, the e-file may open and Re1 will be ready to exploit it.
moves.popup:
c3为d4做准备
一旦d4推进，e线将开放
Re1的价值立刻体现

moves.popup_en: ...h6 prevents Ng5 as Black continues steadily.
moves.popup:
h6防止Ng5
黑方稳步推进

moves.popup_en: Nbd2 develops the knight to support the center.
moves.popup:
Nbd2发展
马占d2，支援中心

moves.popup_en: ...Re8! Black also contests the e-file. The rooks now face each other along the file.
moves.popup:
Re8！黑方也来争e线
黑车到e8——双方在e线相遇

moves.popup_en: Nf1 reroutes the knight toward strong squares, preparing Ng3-f5.
moves.popup:
Nf1马重新部署
准备Ng3-f5强占好格

moves.popup_en: ...Bf8 retreats the bishop as Black rearranges the position.
moves.popup:
Bf8象撤回
黑方调整阵型

moves.popup_en: Ng3 brings the knight to a useful post, controlling f5 and h5.
moves.popup:
Ng3马到好位
控制f5和h5

moves.popup_en: ...g6 defends and discourages Nf5.
moves.popup:
g6防御
阻止Nf5

moves.popup_en: h3 is a useful precaution against ...Bg4 pinning Nf3.
moves.popup:
h3备手
防止Bg4牵制Nf3

moves.popup_en: ...Bg7 develops the bishop, which pressures d4. Black's setup is taking shape.
moves.popup:
Bg7发展
黑方象站g7，压d4
黑方阵型趋于完整

moves.popup_en: d4! White challenges the center. The exchange on e5 may open the e-file, where Re1 is already posted. Black is ready to contest the line as well.
moves.popup:
d4！白方发起中心推进
d4×e5——e线即将开放
Re1已提前就位，黑方也对应积极应对！
